description: Defines classes and functions for buffer allocation and management within the quiche library, including QuicheBufferAllocator, QuicheBufferDeleter, QuicheBuffer, and related utilities.

classes.name: QuicheBufferAllocator
classes.description: Abstract base class for buffer allocators with methods to create and delete buffers.

classes.name: QuicheBufferDeleter
classes.description: Deleter class for managing buffer ownership via std::unique_ptr.

classes.name: QuicheBuffer
classes.description: Mutable buffer class with associated size, supporting copy and move semantics.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Pure virtual method to allocate a new buffer of given size.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Pure virtual method to allocate a new buffer of given size with enable flag.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Pure virtual method to release a buffer.

methods.name: MarkAllocatorIdle
methods.description: Optional method to mark the allocator as idle.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Deletes a buffer using the allocator.

methods.name: MakeUniqueBuffer
methods.description: Creates a unique pointer to a buffer allocated by the given allocator.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Creates a QuicheBuffer by copying data from a string view.

methods.name: CopyFromIovec
methods.description: Creates a QuicheBuffer by copying data from an iovec array.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases ownership of the buffer and resets size.
